# `⋄` — Separator

At statement level, `⋄` separates expressions. A line break does the same.

```apl
x←2 ⋄ y←3 ⋄ x+y    ⍝ 5
```

Inside [brackets](brackets.qmd), `⋄` separates major cells. A trailing `⋄` builds an array from one cell.

```apl
[1 2 ⋄ 3 4]        ⍝ 2 2⍴1 2 3 4
⍴[42 ⋄]            ⍝ 1 1
```

Inside parentheses, `⋄` is a `SYNTAX` error, because parentheses only group.
